author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇵🇰 Murad Saeed is accusing Pakistan's intelligence agencies of something extraordinary:

Outsourcing political repression to the same militants and criminals the state claims to be fighting.

The PTI leader alleges that intelligence personnel, rogue Taliban and hardened criminals are being organized into teams across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to abduct PTI officials and members of the provincial government.

Some, he claims, are being supplied with police and Frontier Corps uniforms. Criminal cases are allegedly being used as leverage to recruit others.

And Saeed says the disappearance of provincial minister Fazal Shakoor is one example of how this system works.

That case is real and deeply strange.

Shakoor was intercepted in broad daylight near the Peshawar motorway. Video shows masked armed men surrounding his vehicle, with one firing at its tyres. His brother subsequently filed a kidnapping case, and the Peshawar High Court has become involved in efforts to locate him.

His accusation is much bigger than another claim of an unlawful arrest.

He is telling PTI to stop viewing the raids, disappearances and alleged abductions as separate events.

They are one connected system.

@PTIofficial 
Source: @MuradSaeedPTI / Writer: Oliver
